## Use JetBrains Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set JetBrains Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'JetBrains Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace",
  "editor.fontLigatures": true
}

Copy

## About the JetBrains Mono coding font

Perfect IDE integration, supporting 145 languages. JetBrains Mono is a free monospace coding font with programming ligatures.

JetBrains Mono is hosted on Google Fonts, so the specimen above renders without installing anything locally. It is one of the 15 CodeFont Top Picks.

## JetBrains Mono FAQ

### Is JetBrains Mono free?

Yes. JetBrains Mono is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does JetBrains Mono support ligatures?

Yes. JetBrains Mono ships programming ligatures. Use the ligature switch above the specimen, or set "editor.fontLigatures": true in VS Code.

### Where can I get JetBrains Mono?

JetBrains Mono is available from GitHub and Google Fonts. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
